title: Boss: the site is down at midnight
concept: Rescue the festival site with every tool

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: The site is down! Use everything you've learned to fix it and push.

hints: The site is broken. Use your git skills to find and fix the problem.
Stash, amend, reset, and reflog are all tools in your belt now.
Answer the question using what you learned in this chapter.

questions.prompt: If a commit broke the site, what's a safe way to undo it?
questions.explanation: Revert creates a new commit that undoes the changes, which is safe to push.

recap: You are ready to handle real-world git emergencies.
